llms: an interactive guide to the parabola in telescopes — a live ray tracer (parabola vs sphere, coma), the sphere-vs-parabola tolerance and Hubble's 2 µm flaw recomputed from its conic constants, the Airy pattern and 1.22 λ/D, collecting area and the 8 m single-mirror limit, Webb's 18 segments phased with a real FFT image, radio-dish surface accuracy (Ruze) and FAST's sphere-to-paraboloid trick, the conic family and Cassegrain / Ritchey–Chrétien designs, and what sits at the focus.
